analysis: The code snippet calls `nextToken()` inside a while loop that checks `tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()`. This check ensures that `nextToken()` is only called when there are more tokens, thus preventing the `NoSuchElementException` that would be thrown if there were no more tokens. Therefore, the exception is fully avoided.
remark: The while loop condition `tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()` guarantees that `nextToken()` is only called when tokens are available, so `NoSuchElementException` cannot occur.
